text:
Sam: Kicking off registry fill for ap-south2 now. Objective: push runtime base, model-shards v3.2 and sidecar images. ETA ~20m.
InfraBot: Started replication job id rep-20260318-77 for ap-south2. Estimated total size 1.2TB.
Maria: Heads up — GPU quota request is still pending. Aj is filing it.
Aj: Filed quota request for +8 A100s (soft limit increase). Ticket CLD-91234.
Sam: Plan: after first few blobs land I'll trigger cache-warmup on one node to prepopulate /var/cache/models and the KV.
Lee: We need an egress ACL for signed URL endpoints: storage.ap-south2.redwood-internal:443 otherwise prefetch fails.
Maria: Confirmed egress rule added: 10.20.0.0/16 -> storage.ap-south2.redwood-internal:443.
InfraBot: rep-20260318-77: 4/12 blobs uploaded, avg 9MB/s, ETA ~18m.
Sam: Starting seed job: `kubectl apply -f deploy/seed-job.yaml --namespace infra-seed --context=gke-ap-south2`
Nadia: Reminder: the job spec needs `imagePullSecrets: [reg-secret-ap-south2]` or pulls will fail.
Sam: Added `reg-secret-ap-south2` to the job and re-applied.
InfraBot: rep-20260318-77: completed. checksum: sha256:abcd1234ef56.
Sam: Cache-warmup running on gpu-03 (prefetcher pod). Logs: "prefetch shard-0: ok" "prefetch shard-1: ok" "prefetch shard-5: 404 retrying".
Lee: 404 was replication lag on object store, retried and succeeded a minute later.
Aj: Quota approved for +8 GPUs, autoscaler will spin up nodes; expected ready in ~12m.
Maria: Cost FYI: cross-region transfer ~1.2TB ~ $120 estimate + registry storage $45. Logged to cost-tracker.
Sam: Handoff checklist for oncall: 1) nodes Ready 2) prefetch finished 3) KV hit >=90% 4) run canary voice traffic.
Oncall: Acknowledged, will run canary once nodes report Ready.
Sam: Canary started. Running 100 synthetic requests against canary pool.
Oncall: Canary results: p50 within baseline, 95th under SLO, KV hit 94%. No errors.
Maria: Saving notes to runbook: add step "pre-warm cache after registry fill" and mention egress ACL + imagePullSecret requirement.
Sam: Closing handoff — markers: rep job id rep-20260318-77, cache checksum sha256:abcd1234ef56, canary id can-20260318-09. :tada:
InfraBot: Created runbook update PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/431
